high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the verified user "manushi_chhillar." The post features a woman sitting on a boat with a serene water backdrop. She is dressed in an elaborate, intricately embroidered white lehenga, which is a traditional Indian outfit. The lehenga has detailed lacework and embellishments, and she is wearing a matching blouse with long sleeves. Her jewelry includes a large, ornate necklace with multiple pendants and a ring on her left hand.
